title: OXTR binding-site catalogue
status: Source catalogue with a reproducible exploratory coordinate experiment

region.selection: Ensembl OXTR gene body plus 10,000 bases on each genomic side
region.scope: A defined locus window; distal regulatory elements outside it are not captured. Overlapping records may extend beyond its boundaries.

interpretation: The original 15 sites are one human promoter study’s reported motif set. The catalogue expands the evidence base, but overlapping reports, broad regions, predictions and species are not added into one confirmed-site total.
coordinate_convention: Database intervals are GRCh38/hg38, 0-based start and exclusive end. Literature coordinates retain their original TSS/ATG/CpG anchors and genome builds. Unrecovered values are null; CSV blanks represent null unless the typed schema says otherwise.
planned_views: Original DNA line with biological coordinates
Full-position circle preserving relative spacing and a fixed origin
Modulus 9 view alongside the uncompressed positions
analysis_status: Source observations remain unchanged. experiment-v1 supplies fixed DNA-line, full-circle and M9 mappings with computational checks. No enrichment test, new motif scan or biological significance score has been applied.

resources.name: JASPAR 2026
resources.evidence: Published motif predictions and PFM templates
resources.note: 9,164 meet UCSC’s default score >=400 display threshold. All 217,857 returned predictions are retained. Several models and strands can overlap one location. Score is a motif-match statistic, not an OXTR regulatory probability.

resources.name: ENCODE 3 / UCSC
resources.note: 133 assayed targets across aggregated experimental contexts. Includes coregulators; not 133 confirmed OXTR-regulating TFs. Provenance joins each cluster to its experiment and cell type.

resources.name: ORegAnno / UCSC
resources.note: Annotation class and factor are unresolved for most returned rows. Regional overlap alone does not establish OXTR regulation.

resources.name: TRANSFAC
resources.note: Public product documentation reviewed. No licensed export or redistribution permission available; no protected entries copied.

resources.name: TFBSdb
resources.note: Indexed OXTR page returns HTTP 404. Search snippets are not imported as a verified database export.

resources.name: ReMap
resources.note: No additional ReMap records counted in this release.

resources.name: ChIP-Atlas
resources.note: Gene-target associations and precise binding intervals are distinct; no extra sites counted.

resources.name: Wolfram
resources.note: A future analysis tool, not an experimental binding-site source.

evidence.label: Methylation-associated motif annotations
evidence.finding: The paper relates methylation measurements to candidate regulatory motifs.
evidence.limitation: These coordinates are CpG anchors, not motif coordinates. No new binding-site count is inferred.

evidence.label: OREG1492306
evidence.finding: The paper references an EGR1-associated ORegAnno region.
evidence.limitation: Annotation reused by the paper, not a new EGR1 binding experiment.

evidence.label: BrainTF human brain occupancy
evidence.methods: Human postmortem brain ChIP-seq; review of author replication tests, FRiP and HOT-region annotations.
evidence.finding: 126 screened protein-occupancy observations overlap the OXTR window, representing 43 targets across 13 contexts. 114 overlap the defined proximal promoter.
evidence.reported_position: Individual GRCh38 peak intervals are in study-additions-v1/braintf-peaks.json.
evidence.coordinate_status: Individual regional observations retained separately; no single precise binding-site coordinate assigned
evidence.limitation: Peak observations across assay contexts, not unique sites or independent donors. The experiments share four postmortem donors across regions. Repeated contexts do not establish population replication. Assayed targets include chromatin-associated proteins and cofactors as well as transcription factors. ChIP-seq measures regional occupancy; it does not locate a contact nucleotide.

evidence.label: OCE7 enhancer reporter evidence
evidence.methods: Human candidate enhancer DNA in mouse hypothalamic-cell luciferase assays and mouse reporter experiments.
evidence.finding: OCE1, OCE5 and OCE7 enhanced reporter activity in mouse hypothalamic cells. The tested DNA was human. OCE7 also drove reporter activity in mouse olfactory bulb at P28 and P56; adult hypothalamic activity was not detected.
evidence.reported_position: OCE7 reported hg38 chr3:8757366–8759184; candidate interval and tested construct boundaries retained separately.
evidence.coordinate_status: Individual regional observations retained separately; no single precise binding-site coordinate assigned
evidence.limitation: Reporter activity does not establish a named transcription-factor binding site or causal regulation of native human OXTR. The reported OCE7 candidate interval and the Table 1 luciferase-primer span differ. Reported intervals and primer matches are retained separately, without a precise binding-site overlay.

coverage: Broad web and bibliographic discovery plus selected primary-source review. This is a documented first collection, not a completed systematic review or a census of every OXTR regulator. Genome-wide distal elements, all cell states and all databases remain outside its scope.

categories.label: Laboratory tested
categories.definition: The record reports a laboratory assay. Includes positive, mixed and negative results; a group-level test does not resolve every member.

categories.label: Binding evidence
categories.definition: Reported DNA binding or regional occupancy, at the resolution and in the system stated by the source.

categories.label: Functional evidence
categories.definition: An element, region or element-based reporter has an experimental regulatory response. This does not imply every nucleotide or predicted motif was independently validated.

categories.label: Annotation or prediction
categories.definition: Sequence or database annotation; direct binding is not established by the annotation alone.

categories.label: Regulatory context
categories.definition: Evidence concerning gene regulation without an independently resolved binding site in this record.

coordinate_experiment.status: Exploratory coordinate mapping with Python, Biopython and Wolfram checks; biological association untested

binding_interpretation.scope: Source-supported interpretation of the current mapped observations; source coordinates and measurements are unchanged.

priority.label: Binding detected at a defined sequence
priority.description: A positive binding result at a specified DNA sequence is the most direct anchor for a location comparison. Check the protein, assay and biological context.

priority.label: Protein association detected across a region
priority.description: ENCODE and BrainTF supply experimental support over a stretch of DNA. Resolve the site within it and inspect the contributing cell types and experiments.

priority.label: Sequence match predicted
priority.description: JASPAR matches are candidates for exploration and experimental follow-up. A model match alone does not establish binding at that location.

binding_interpretation.priority_note: This is an Atlas research-priority guide, not a platform trust score. A published paper can contain any evidence type. Relevant context, assay quality and replication matter. Binding and effects on gene activity are separate outcomes.
binding_interpretation.geometry_note: Biological support does not establish statistical significance or predictive value for an Atlas geometric match. That requires a defined comparison and appropriate controls.
binding_interpretation.negative_controls: No negative binding controls have been curated for this coordinate experiment. An absent record or an unclassified outcome is not a negative experiment.

outcome_vocabulary.binding_detected: Positive binding result reported for the named DNA element under the stated assay conditions.
outcome_vocabulary.regional_association_detected: Positive regional protein-association signal; direct sequence-specific binding and an exact motif are not established by this cluster alone.
outcome_vocabulary.binding_not_detected: No binding detected under specified assay conditions; assign only from an explicit source result.
outcome_vocabulary.mixed_or_unclear: Results differ or are inconclusive; retain each assay and condition.
outcome_vocabulary.prediction_only: The record reports a computational match; no location-specific binding result is established by this record.
outcome_vocabulary.not_classified: Outcome not classified in this layer; not equivalent to untested or negative.

encode.label: Regional association detected
encode.result: A ChIP-seq peak cluster records protein association with this DNA region. Binding can be direct or mediated by other proteins; the plotted centre is not an identified binding site.

encode.review_depth: UCSC ENCODE 3 track methods and archived cluster provenance; individual raw experiments not reanalysed

jaspar.expression_effect: Effect on OXTR expression not established by this prediction
jaspar.review_depth: JASPAR documentation and archived UCSC prediction

braintf.label: Regional association detected
braintf.result: A screened BrainTF ChIP-seq peak records protein association across this region; an exact binding sequence is unresolved.
braintf.context: Human postmortem brain; the context is retained on each observation.
braintf.expression_effect: Effect on native OXTR expression not established by this occupancy measurement.
braintf.review_depth: Public processed peaks, author replication tests, FRiP and HOT annotations reviewed; raw reads not reanalysed.

TFBS012.label: Binding detected
TFBS012.result: US-1 showed protein binding in the reported DNA-binding assays. The specific binding protein remains unresolved.
TFBS012.context: Nuclear extracts from human term-pregnant and non-pregnant myometrium (uterine muscle).
TFBS012.expression_effect: Enhancer activity reported in an artificial reporter construct in cultured SKN cells; not a direct measurement of the element’s effect at its native OXTR locus.
TFBS012.review_depth: Published abstract reviewed; full-text methods and controls not independently reassessed

TFBS013.label: Binding detected

TFBS013.expression_effect: A role in OXTR upregulation was proposed; a causal effect on native OXTR expression is not established by the reviewed abstract.

braintf.selection: One matching QC row; author replication test passes; both reported FRiP values at least 1%; overlapping author union regions labelled NOT-HOT; no identified target-label conflict.
braintf.FRiP_interpretation: The 1% cutoff is an explicit Atlas review filter, not a universal quality threshold or the authors’ replication-pass definition.
braintf.HOT_interpretation: Uses the authors’ union-region annotation; high-occupancy, conflicting and unassessed classifications are excluded.
braintf.count_unit: Peak observations across assay contexts, not unique sites or independent donors.
braintf.coordinate_conversion: Author GRanges starts were converted from 1-based to 0-based by subtracting one; exclusive ends equal the converted start plus GRanges width.
braintf.donor_limit: The experiments share four postmortem donors across regions. Repeated contexts do not establish population replication.
braintf.assay_limit: Assayed targets include chromatin-associated proteins and cofactors as well as transcription factors. ChIP-seq measures regional occupancy; it does not locate a contact nucleotide.
braintf.contextual_annotations: Overlaps with existing ENCODE and PsychSCREEN brain candidate regulatory regions are spatial context, not independent validation of OXTR regulation.
braintf.review_scope: 13 author-packaged peak datasets and 226 additional public portal peak files inspected. The browser retains the conservative subset; all 390 locus observations, including histone marks, remain in the review download.
braintf.excluded_result: No nominal allele-specific result in the separately reviewed BrainTF table passed BH-adjusted P < 0.05 at this locus; none is presented as confirmed allele-specific binding.

enhancer.result: OCE1, OCE5 and OCE7 enhanced reporter activity in mouse hypothalamic cells. The tested DNA was human. OCE7 also drove reporter activity in mouse olfactory bulb at P28 and P56; adult hypothalamic activity was not detected.
enhancer.atlas_scope: OCE2, OCE6 and OCE7 reported regions intersect the current window. OCE2 and OCE6 were negative in the reporter assay. The window is unchanged.
enhancer.boundary: Reporter activity does not establish a named transcription-factor binding site or causal regulation of native human OXTR.
enhancer.coordinates: The reported OCE7 candidate interval and the Table 1 luciferase-primer span differ. Reported intervals and primer matches are retained separately, without a precise binding-site overlay.

study_additions.geometry_scope: The Studies comparison and data browser both include 128 observations: US-1, US-2 and 126 screened BrainTF occupancy regions. Region centres are plotting representatives, not precise binding sites. The enhancer paper remains functional literature evidence.
